freezerRecommendations.reason: Most flexible confirmed protein deal this cycle; portion into 1.5 to 2 lb freezer packs for taco bowls, skillet dinners, or stuffed peppers.

freezerRecommendations.item: ALDI Black Angus petite sirloin steaks
freezerRecommendations.reason: Best confirmed ALDI protein sale found; slice thin before freezing for fast stir-fries and fajita-style bowls.
Good special-occasion seafood price if locally available; buy only what you will cook within 1-2 days or freeze immediately.

meals.name: HT Ground Chuck Taco Quinoa Bowls
meals.macroFit: Drain the beef well and keep the portion to 5 oz cooked with high-fiber quinoa, beans, and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Cook quinoa while the beef browns.
Brown ground chuck with chili powder, cumin, garlic, and pepper; drain thoroughly.
Char or microwave corn, then cut kernels from the cob.
Chop romaine, peppers, and tomatoes; rinse black beans.
Build bowls with quinoa, beans, vegetables, beef, lime, and salsa or Greek yogurt if desired.

meals.name: ALDI Petite Sirloin Broccoli Soba Stir-Fry
meals.protein: Black Angus Choice Beef Petite Sirloin Steaks
meals.macroFit: Thin-sliced sirloin keeps portions controlled while soba and vegetables make the plate filling.
instructions: Cook soba noodles and rinse briefly.
Slice sirloin very thin and season with ginger, garlic, pepper, and a little low-sodium tamari.
Stir-fry beef in a hot skillet for 2 to 3 minutes, then remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, snap peas, and carrots until crisp-tender.
Toss noodles, vegetables, and beef together; finish with lime or rice vinegar.

meals.name: HT New York Strip Fajita Rice Plates
meals.macroFit: A 4 oz steak portion plus beans, brown rice, and lots of fajita vegetables keeps the premium cut balanced.
instructions: Slice peppers and onions; warm rice and rinsed beans.
Season steak with cumin, chili powder, garlic, pepper, and lime.
Sear steak 3 to 4 minutes per side, rest, then slice thin.
Sauté peppers and onions in the same pan until tender-crisp.
Plate rice, beans, vegetables, romaine, tomato, and sliced steak.

meals.name: HT Lobster Tail Summer Corn Bowls
meals.protein: Wild Caught North Atlantic Lobster Tails
meals.macroFit: Lean lobster makes a lighter high-protein bowl; farro and vegetables add fiber without heavy sauces.
instructions: Cook farro according to package directions.
Split lobster shells and broil or air-fry tails with lemon, pepper, and a small brush of olive oil until opaque.
Sauté zucchini and corn kernels until just tender.
Toss spinach and tomatoes with lemon juice.
Serve lobster over farro with the warm vegetables and salad.

meals.name: HT Ground Chuck Stuffed Pepper Skillet
meals.macroFit: Classic stuffed-pepper flavor without the long bake; lentils and brown rice stretch the beef cleanly.
instructions: Brown ground chuck in a large skillet; drain thoroughly.
Add chopped bell peppers, garlic, Italian seasoning, and crushed tomatoes.
Simmer 8 to 10 minutes while the brown rice warms.
Stir in lentils, rice, and spinach until spinach wilts.
Serve as bowls; add a small sprinkle of cheese only if desired.

meals.name: ALDI Petite Sirloin Chimichurri Sweet Potato Plates
meals.protein: Black Angus Choice Beef Petite Sirloin Steaks
meals.macroFit: Lean sirloin, sweet potatoes, and two vegetables make a simple balanced plate with no heavy sauce.
instructions: Microwave sweet potatoes until tender, then split.
Steam or sauté broccoli until bright green.
Season sirloin with pepper, garlic, and a little salt; sear 3 to 4 minutes per side and rest.
Mix quick chimichurri with parsley, vinegar, garlic, pepper, and a small amount of olive oil.
Slice steak thin and serve with sweet potatoes, broccoli, cucumber-tomato salad, and chimichurri.
